description: Defines the 'dmrs_uplink_config' structure and related nested structures for configuring uplink demodulation reference signals in 5G NR, including parameters for different OFDM schemes, DMRS types, and PTRS configuration.

classes.name: dmrs_uplink_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for uplink demodulation reference signals in PUSCH, including parameters for DMRS type, position, PTRS, and transform precoding.

classes.name: dmrs_uplink_config::transform_precoder_disabled
classes.description: Parameters for DMRS with Cyclic Prefix OFDM when transform precoder is disabled.

classes.name: dmrs_uplink_config::transform_precoder_enabled
classes.description: Parameters for DMRS with DFT-s-OFDM (Transform Precoding) when enabled.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for 'dmrs_uplink_config' to compare all configuration parameters.
